_howToEdit: Add one object to "events" per event. Publish confirmed details only. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD; events on or after today show as Upcoming, earlier ones as Past. Use series "invisible-handshake" for The Invisible Handshake Series sessions, or null for other ESC activities. Photos go in public/images/events/ and are listed as "images/events/your-photo.jpg". See _example for every field, and copy it into the events list to use it.

_example.title: The Invisible Handshake Series: Session 1
_example.summary: One or two sentences announcing the event.
_example.recap: A short recap written after the session.
